[Section] jiant System Overview ::: jiant Deployment Environments
[source_id=50] jiant runs on consumer-grade hardware or in cluster environments with or without CUDA GPUs. The jiant repository also contains documentation and configuration files demonstrating how to deploy jiant in Kubernetes clusters on Google Kubernetes Engine.
